comparison.objective: Candidate sorts open and closed cartons on a running belt; PR-2233 places a glass unit onto two setting blocks in a frame without touching the sill.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed flap-safe grasping and loose-content stabilization versus delicate large-panel handling, narrow-channel alignment, and simultaneous seating on two supports.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires spill-free tray placement/release for open cartons and untouched belt passage for closed cartons; PR-2233 requires released, still glass resting on correctly placed blocks within centering/tilt bounds, with any sill touch permanently failing.
comparison.reason: Both demand damage-aware placement, but conveyor classification and loaded-container transport differ materially from precision glazing alignment.
